description: Python is a language for giving a computer clear steps to follow. You can use it to count points, sort a list or work with information in a file. Begin with a short message. Then learn about numbers, words, choices and repeated steps. Python examples on this site show the code and its answer. To run them, use Python 3 on your computer.
versionNote: Written for Python 3.13 (released October 2024). Every example also runs unchanged on Python 3.14 and later 3.x releases.
whatYouWillLearn: Show a message and save values with names
Use numbers, words and lists in a program
Make choices and repeat a group of steps
Read files and organise a bigger program
